title: Evidence ancestry guard
responsibility: Rejects evidence paths outside the trusted run directory or with a non-directory or symlink component beneath that root.

inputs.name: evidenceDirectoryFailure.directory
inputs.description: Evidence directory to inspect, lexically beneath the trusted root.

inputs.name: evidenceDirectoryFailure.root
inputs.description: Trusted scratch directory that anchors the evidence path.

outputs.name: evidenceDirectoryFailure
outputs.description: An ancestry failure message when the path escapes the root or a component is missing/not a directory/symlink; undefined when the existing path is safe or not yet created.
